# awscc_dataexchange_event_action (Resource)

An event action is an AWS Data Exchange resource that automatically exports data set revisions to Amazon S3 when a revision is published.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `action` (Attributes) What occurs after a certain event. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--action))
- `event` (Attributes) What occurs to start an action. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--event))

### Optional

- `tags` (Attributes Set) The tags for the event action. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The ARN for the event action.
- `created_at` (String) The date and time that the event action was created, in ISO 8601 format.
- `event_action_id` (String) The unique identifier for the event action.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `updated_at` (String) The date and time that the event action was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.

<a id="nestedatt--action"></a>
### Nested Schema for `action`

Optional:

- `export_revision_to_s3` (Attributes) Details of the operation to be performed by the job. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--action--export_revision_to_s3))

<a id="nestedatt--action--export_revision_to_s3"></a>
### Nested Schema for `action.export_revision_to_s3`

Optional:

- `encryption` (Attributes) Encryption configuration of the export job. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--action--export_revision_to_s3--encryption))
- `revision_destination` (Attributes) A revision destination is the Amazon S3 bucket folder destination to where the export will be sent. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--action--export_revision_to_s3--revision_destination))

<a id="nestedatt--action--export_revision_to_s3--encryption"></a>
### Nested Schema for `action.export_revision_to_s3.encryption`

Optional:

- `kms_key_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the AWS KMS key you want to use to encrypt the Amazon S3 objects.
- `type` (String) The type of server side encryption used for encrypting the objects in Amazon S3.


<a id="nestedatt--action--export_revision_to_s3--revision_destination"></a>
### Nested Schema for `action.export_revision_to_s3.revision_destination`

Optional:

- `bucket` (String) The Amazon S3 bucket that is the destination for the event action.
- `key_pattern` (String) A string representing the pattern for generated names of the individual assets in the revision.




<a id="nestedatt--event"></a>
### Nested Schema for `event`

Optional:

- `revision_published` (Attributes) Information about the published revision. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--event--revision_published))

<a id="nestedatt--event--revision_published"></a>
### Nested Schema for `event.revision_published`

Optional:

- `data_set_id` (String) The data set ID of the published revision.



<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Optional:

- `key` (String) The key name of the tag.
- `value` (String) The value for the tag.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_dataexchange_event_action.example
  identity = {
    arn = "arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `arn` (String) The ARN for the event action

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_dataexchange_event_action.example
  id = "arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_dataexchange_event_action.example "arn"
```
